name: Knott's Ghost Town Grill Sliced Smoked Turkey Breast & Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: Thick slices of tender smoked turkey breast served with real mashed Idaho potatoes and poultry gravy. Very lean, bioavailable protein that requires minimal digestive breakdown.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Smoked Turkey Dinner with extra mashed potatoes; request gravy on top (hold cranberry relish).
watchOuts: Hold whole cranberry relish if served
